changes: Producer-authored trust_status is no longer rendered as authoritative dashboard trust state.
A complete appraisal/acceptance reference set renders only REFERENCE_BOUND_UNVERIFIED; missing binding renders UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED.
quarantine_reason is reduced to a bounded reason-code enum plus reference hashes; arbitrary nested/free-text payload is omitted.
prediction_outcome is reduced to a whitelisted scalar/reference projection and requires closure_id plus closure_hash references.
Malformed/non-scalar entity_id is rejected instead of generic str() coercion.
Non-scalar summary is rejected; presentation truncation remains bounded and TEST_REQUIRED.
authority_from_drive remains exactly 0; external_action_set and action_buttons remain empty; canonical_personality_mutation remains false.
risks_left_for_quantum_independent_revie: REFERENCE_BOUND_UNVERIFIED currently proves only presence/shape of appraisal and acceptance references inside the dashboard projection; it does not independently resolve registry freshness, revocation, provider authority, or installation/workspace binding.

closure_hash is a projection reference supplied to the adapter; the adapter does not independently recompute a canonical OutcomeClosure hash. Quantum should decide whether owner-visible outcome projection must consume a host-issued validated closure display receipt instead of reference presence alone.

Unknown quarantine reason codes currently degrade to UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED instead of quarantining the whole dashboard event; this is a presentation-policy choice and remains subject to independent review.
Dashboard minimization must not replace or truncate the append-only ledger's full audit reconstruction data.
